plain_english_policy: Use of an independent or bipartisan commission to oversee the process of drawing electoral district boundaries.

effects.rationale: Removing partisan control of redistricting implies greater public or non-partisan oversight, aligning with popular sovereignty.
The proposal explicitly introduces a third-party (commission) to intervene in the redistricting process, which is traditionally controlled by legislative bodies.
The commission would be a public entity (state-level) rather than a private one, though it could include bipartisan members.
